question: Should OpenClaw accept bundled dashboard log-tail and command-output widgets now, and what redaction, permission, retention, export, and command-output boundary must those widgets follow?
rationale: The request is useful and mostly aligned with Control UI ergonomics, but it creates a new operator-facing surface for sensitive logs and command output and depends on unmerged dashboard/binding contracts that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Review
options.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/computed binding work first, then implement these widgets against approved read-only data contracts.

options.title: Narrow To Existing Read-Only Sources
options.body: Allow a focused implementation only for existing `logs.tail` and already-recorded command-output data, excluding new command execution, generic stream bindings, or export behavior until separately approved.

options.title: Defer Bundled Widgets
options.body: Leave this as roadmap context and ask contributors to focus on external plugin/API gaps until maintainers sponsor bundled dashboard builtins.

recommendation.title: Stage After Substrate And Security Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, land or reject the dashboard substrate and stream/computed binding work first, then implement these widgets against approved read-only data contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest merged-history signal for the plugin-tab seam and current Control UI log-tail/dashboard paths this work builds on.
